accomplishments.statement: Contributed Python checks for missing survey values while working with a bilingual research team. The checks that I contributed checked for missing values in the survey data. This was a contribution as a team member, not leadership of the study. No numeric improvement was measured for these checks.

job_text: Python data-cleaning experience required. Research leadership preferred.
review_focus: Combine repeated descriptions of missing-value checks.
Retain bilingual team context, contribution rather than leadership, and no measured numeric gains.
Readability is reviewed separately from length and literal findings.
